plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect reduced upside potential compared to other modes.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the mandate and reduce concentration.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate drawdowns with balanced upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the mandate and reduce concentration.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases leverage and concentration, which amplifies both upside and drawdown. Be aware of leveraged ETF decay and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.
